situation: I replied-all on a client thread and it went to their whole distribution list, including my boss Karen's joke that their CFO is 'hard work'. Need to tell Karen on Slack right now.
reply: Karen, heads up: at 11:20 I replied-all on the Northwind thread and it went to their full distribution list, including your line about their CFO. I've recalled it, which caught about half the recipients, and I've drafted a short note to Priya at Northwind that I'd like you to see before it goes. I can have it in your DMs in 10 minutes. Sorry, this one's mine. From now on I strip external addresses before replying on any internal thread.
note: A recall is only a partial fix, so say exactly how partial; overclaiming the fix is the second mistake.

situation: I put the wrong date for the team offsite in the calendar invite I sent to everyone. Small thing but people might book trains. Posting in the team channel.
reply: Correction: the offsite is Thursday 29 October, not Friday. My mistake, the invite's updated. If you've already booked travel for Friday, message me and I'll sort the change.
note: Small mistake, small message. One line of ownership, then the fix.

situation: 我是公司出纳，昨天给供应商重复付了一笔货款，多付了38,000元，今天对账才发现。要跟财务总监王总说，怎么开口？
reply: 王总，向您报告一个我的失误：昨天给华诚包装付款时重复提交了一次，多付了38,000元，今天上午对账时发现的。我已经联系了对方财务刘姐，她确认收到两笔，同意本周五前退回，我会盯到到账。原因是我提交前没有核对付款记录。以后每笔付款提交前，我都先在系统里查一遍历史记录。钱到账后我第一时间告诉您。
note: 先说错误和金额，再说已经做了什么，最后一句防范措施，不要反复道歉。

situation: I'm a freelance email marketer. This morning I sent my client Rachel's newsletter to 8,400 subscribers with the code FALL40 instead of FALL14. 31 orders have already used it. I need to email her now.
reply: Hi Rachel, I made a mistake in this morning's newsletter: the discount code went out as FALL40, 40% off, instead of FALL14. So far 31 orders have used it, roughly $1,100 more in discounts than planned. I turned FALL40 off at 11:20, so no new orders can use it. I'll send you the full list of those 31 orders by 2pm, and I'll credit the extra discount against this month's invoice. From now on I'll send you a test email with the live code before every send. I'm sorry about this one.
note: To a client, lead with the number and the fix already made, offer to carry the cost, and apologise once, at the end.

situation: I'm a junior analyst. Two weeks ago I sent the Q3 pricing deck to our VP, Marisa, and just found a formula error: monthly churn is 4.1%, not 2.4%. She's already quoted the 2.4% in the board pre-read for the October 8 meeting. I need to tell my manager Tom first.
reply: Tom, I found an error in the Q3 pricing deck I sent on 15 September: monthly churn on slide 6 should be 4.1%, not 2.4%. A formula pointed at the wrong range, and Marisa has quoted the 2.4% in the board pre-read for 8 October. I've corrected the deck and rechecked every other figure against the source data, and the rest holds. Can we tell Marisa together today, so she has the corrected slide before the pre-read goes out? From now on I'll have a second person check any number that goes to the VP.
note: Error found late and already quoted upward: tell your manager first, bring the fix, and ask to escalate together the same day.

situation: 我是部门经理，答应帮组员陈佳提交今年的晋升材料，结果系统9月25号就截止了，我记成了30号，没交上。她还不知道，今天要跟她说。
reply: 佳佳，有件事要跟你说清楚：你的晋升材料我没在9月25号截止前提交，我把日期记成了30号，责任完全在我。今天上午我已经找了HR的周姐，她说可以走补录，需要部门总监签字，我下午就去找刘总，明天下班前把结果告诉你。如果补录不成，明年3月那一轮我第一个提你，并把这次的情况写进说明。对不起，这件事受影响的是你。以后所有截止日期我都会提前一周设提醒。
note: 经理向下属认错也要先说结论和责任，再说补救和时间，别让她反过来安慰你。

situation: 今朝、取引先の山本様に旧単価のままの見積書を送ってしまい、部長に報告したら「またか。先月も似たようなミスがあったよね」と言われた。訂正版はもう送ってある。どう返せばいい？
reply: おっしゃる通りです。先月に続いてのミスで、申し訳ありません。訂正版は10時半に送付済みで、山本様にはお電話でも経緯をお伝えしました。今後は見積書を送る前に単価表の更新日を確認し、佐藤さんにダブルチェックをお願いします。山本様から返事があり次第、すぐにご報告します。
note: 二度目だと言われても言い訳はせずに認め、具体的な再発防止策を一つ示し、あとはこまめな報告で信頼を取り戻す。

situation: I was cleaning up our team's shared slide deck last night and accidentally deleted my colleague Priya's six slides for her client pitch this Thursday. I restored four from version history but two are gone. She doesn't know yet.
reply: Priya, I need to flag something: last night I deleted your six slides in the shared Harlow deck while I was tidying it up. I've restored four from version history, slides 12 to 15, and they're exactly as you left them. Slides 16 and 17, the pricing comparison, didn't come back. I'm sorry, that's on me. I can rebuild them from the pricing sheet this morning and have them to you by 1pm for you to check, if that helps. From now on I'll make my own copy before I tidy a shared deck.
note: To a peer whose work you broke: the damage precisely, what's already recovered, an offer to do the rebuild yourself, and one prevention step.

situation: 我是后端开发。今天上午10:15上线订单提醒功能时发送任务配置写错了，大约12000个用户每人收到了三条一样的短信。10:32我已经回滚。要马上在工作群里跟技术负责人周总说。
reply: 周总，报告一个我的失误：今天上午10:15上线订单提醒功能时，我把发送任务配置错了，大约12000个用户每人重复收到三条相同的短信，多出的短信费约1200元。10:32已经回滚，之后没有再发出重复短信。客服的统一回复口径我已经发给小林，11点前把受影响用户名单和费用明细发您。对不起，这次是我的问题。以后批量发送类功能上线前，我都先在测试环境按真实用户量跑一遍，再请一位同事复核配置。
note: 先说错误和影响范围，再说已经止损和下一步的时间，最后一条具体的防范措施；只道歉一次，不解释为什么会写错。

situation: I'm an in-house recruiter. At 11:20 today I sent our rejection email to Maya Chen, who is actually our top finalist for the product designer role, instead of another candidate. I've already emailed Maya. Need to tell the hiring manager, Sam, on Slack.
reply: Sam, I made a mistake: at 11:20 I sent Maya Chen our rejection email, which was meant for another candidate. I've emailed her to say it was sent in error and she's very much still in the process, and I've asked for a 10-minute call today. No reply yet. I'm sorry, I picked the wrong name from the dropdown. From now on I'm checking every rejection against the tracker before it goes. I'll update you as soon as I've spoken to her.
note: Headline first, the fix already in motion, one apology and one prevention step; Sam hears it from you before Maya has to raise it.

situation: My manager Deepa just messaged me 'Why am I hearing from finance that Monday's invoice batch failed?' I spotted it yesterday afternoon and was planning to fix it before telling her. 46 invoices, about $38,000, didn't go out.
reply: You should have heard it from me yesterday, Deepa, and that's on me. Monday's batch failed for 46 invoices, about $38,000, because I uploaded the file with last quarter's tax code. I've corrected the file and it's re-running now; finance will confirm by 3pm and I'll forward it to you straight away. From now on I'll flag a problem the moment I see it, even before I have the fix.
note: When your boss finds out first, own the delay as its own mistake in the first line, then give the facts and the fix.

situation: Ich bin Werkstudentin in einer kleinen Webagentur und kümmere mich um die Domainverlängerungen. Die Domain unseres Kunden Bäckerei Hoffmann ist heute Nacht abgelaufen, weil die hinterlegte Kreditkarte ungültig war und ich die Warnmail übersehen habe. Website und E-Mail sind seit 6 Uhr down, und ich muss es meinem Chef Herrn Brandt sagen.
reply: Herr Brandt, ich muss Ihnen einen Fehler melden: Die Domain von Bäckerei Hoffmann ist heute Nacht abgelaufen, weil die hinterlegte Karte ungültig war und ich die Warnmail vom 15. September übersehen habe. Website und Postfächer sind seit etwa 6 Uhr nicht erreichbar. Ich habe die Domain um 8:40 mit der Firmenkarte verlängert; laut Anbieter kann es bis zu 24 Stunden dauern, bis alles wieder läuft, und ich melde mich um 12 Uhr mit dem Stand. Soll ich Frau Hoffmann selbst anrufen, oder möchten Sie das übernehmen? Es tut mir leid. Ab heute stehen alle Ablaufdaten im Teamkalender, mit Erinnerung zwei Wochen vorher.
note: Wenn die Lösung noch läuft: sagen, was schon getan ist, wann das nächste Update kommt, und beim Kundenkontakt fragen statt eigenmächtig handeln.

situation: In standup this morning our lead Anna said Leo's deploy broke staging yesterday. It was actually my config change at 4:10pm; Leo deployed right after me and it surfaced then. Leo looked embarrassed and didn't say anything. I want to message Anna now.
reply: Anna, a correction to this morning: staging broke yesterday because of my config change at 4:10pm, not Leo's deploy. His went out right after mine, which is why it looked like his. I reverted my change at 9:20 today and staging has been green since. I'm sorry, and I'm sorry Leo took the heat for it in standup. I'd like to say this in the team channel too so the record is straight, unless you'd rather do it. From now on I'll post in #deploys before any config change to staging.
note: When someone else was blamed for your mistake, correcting the record the same day, publicly and to them, is part of the fix.
